a: A thesis states the main claim a paper will support.
A topic sentence states the main idea of a paragraph.
Cite sources to credit authors and allow verification.
Active voice is often clearer: The team shipped the feature.
Cut filler words; prefer short clear sentences.
An outline organizes points before drafting.
Revision improves structure and clarity after a first draft.
Match vocabulary and detail level to the reader.
A summary restates main ideas without new arguments.
Email subjects should be specific and scannable.
